Subject: Your anticipatory bail matter - Anticipatory Bail Application No. 670/2020

Dear Ms. Rajan,

Thank you for meeting us on 21 September 2020 about your dispute with Ajay Malhotra. As we understand it, the complaint alleges negligence during treatment.

Our advice is to rely on the expert committee opinion that there was no gross negligence. Please collect the treatment records and the expert committee opinion and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹58,90,000.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa
